text.en:
Today you learn if.
If it rains, we will stay inside.
If you call, I will answer.
First the if part. Then the plan.
Will goes in the plan part.
Not after if.

You can start with if.
If she asks, I will help.
Or start with the plan.
I will text you if the forecast changes.
With she, he or one thing, add s.
He stops if he sees the sign.

You will say what happens if something happens.
Ask too: Will you wait if I am late?
Sometimes after if comes a request.
If you need help, press this button.
If you find my pass, let me know.
No will in these.
